description: KNOWN DEFECT, PINNED DELIBERATELY. Samsung Health emits a whole-night 'session' segment alongside the fine-grained stages, including the awake ones. 'session' counts as asleep, so the union of asleep intervals swallows every awake period: this night reports four hours asleep and 100% efficiency despite two awakenings totalling an hour. Seen on real data — a night with 26 awakenings reported 6h16m and 100%, where subtracting the awake union (or ignoring 'session' when finer stages exist — both agree) gives 5h30m and 88%. The golden below records what BOTH readers currently do, so the bug cannot quietly change; it is not what they should do. Fixing it is a change to the read semantics in DESIGN.md §4.3 and must land in the Flutter and PHP readers together, updating this golden in the same commit.
